intro.en: The thermal limit of a finished lead depends on its actual route, load and lowest-rated component.
intro.zh: 成品引线的耐热边界取决于真实路径、负载及额定值最低的部件。

knowledge.en: Silicone, FEP, PTFE and glass-braid constructions require exact product data; a material name alone is not a rating.
knowledge.zh: 硅橡胶、FEP、PTFE 与玻纤编织结构都要核对准确型号数据，材料名称不能单独代表额定值。

notes.en: Provide the thermal map, current, route, connector drawings, material data and acceptance criteria.
notes.zh: 请提供温度分布、电流、路径、接头图纸、材料数据及验收标准。

delivery.en: Release the complete assembly against approved drawings and project-specific thermal and electrical checks.
delivery.zh: 按获批图纸及项目特定的热工、电气检查放行完整组件。

lead.en: The wire, connector and route share one temperature boundary.
lead.zh: 线材、接头与路径共同决定温度边界。
